output.text: Mr. President, going by the list as Harriman sent it, tanks come first: they ask for 500 a month, and 400 aircraft a month behind that. That is what they asked for, mind you, not what they will get. I can't tell you yet what we can ship against it; that is a question for the Army and for the British, who will want their share. My advice is to tell Stalin something definite soon, even if it is less than the list.
